name: agrinav-perception-ontology
scope: image-space plant classification and localization proposals only
principles: Biological identity and decision role are separate facts.
A weed target requires affirmative evidence; absence of protected crop is not a target.
Unknown or ambiguous vegetation is non-actionable.
Boxes may be derived from masks, but boxes are not canonical treatment geometry.
Model output is a proposal until a human review state is accepted.

biological_classes.name: rice
biological_classes.description: Cultivated rice that must be protected.

biological_classes.name: weed
biological_classes.description: A positively identified biological weed; species may be stored as an attribute.

biological_classes.name: unknown_vegetation
biological_classes.description: Plant material that cannot be resolved safely as protected rice or a weed target.

biological_classes.name: duckweed_or_aquatic_vegetation
biological_classes.description: Aquatic vegetation kept separate until an agronomic policy establishes target status.

biological_classes.name: non_vegetation
biological_classes.description: Soil, water, residue, reflection, shadow, equipment, or other background material.

treatment_eligible.rule: Must be separately reviewed; never infer it from biological class or from absence of rice.

verified_empty.meaning: A human reviewed the full image and found no weed_target objects. It does not mean the image contains no plants.

forbidden_inferences: duckweed_or_aquatic_vegetation => weed_target without an approved policy
